verdict.summary_en: Polish WZ delivery note WZ-261007-439 dated 07.10.2026 from Karton Nowak (Poznań) to the Soony DC Hamburg. It covers POs 4500318722 and 4500318731. Line 1 is CMP-GAM-008 Art Book Grand Heist 6, 12.500 PCS (12,500) in 25 packages. Line 2 is CMP-GAM-011 Activation Code Leaflet, 280.000 PCS (280,000) in 56 packages. Gross weight is 1134 kg and total packages are 81 (25+56, which matches). The goods are on EUR pallets and the sender asks for their return. The note is handwritten-signed 'Meyer K.' in the received-by field. There are no corrections, strike-throughs or stamps, and no receiving date.
red_flags: The note lists two POs but does not say which line belongs to which PO.
The pallets are EUR pallets and the sender asks for them to be returned.
No receiving date or goods-receipt stamp is present, and the signature is undated. There is no note of any quantity check against the order.
observations: The line 1 description is cut off: '(96 p, hard' has no closing bracket.
Quantities use the Polish thousands separator (12.500 = 12500, 280.000 = 280000).
The only handwriting is the signature 'Meyer K.' in blue ink.
The bottom of the page is blank, and there are no stamps.
The page has a barcode at the top right.
